(1)  All  contracts,  agreements,  certificates  or  other
instruments  or  documents  whatsoever  made,  issued  or
executed prior to the date of the commencement of this Act,
by or in favour of the “Society of the Ceylonese Brothers of
St. Joseph” shall be deemed on or after date of commencement
of this Act, to be, and to have been made, issued or executed
by or in favour of the Society of the Sri Lankan Brothers of
Charity.
(2) All suits, actions, appeals and other legal proceedings
instituted by or against the “Society of the Ceyloness Brothers
of St. Joseph” and pending on the day immediately prior to
the date of the commencement of this Act, shall not abate or
be  discontinued,  and  may  be  continued  or  enforced  by  or
against the “Society of the Sri Lankan Brothers of Charity”.
(3) All the rights, liabilities and obligations of the “Society
of the Ceylonese Brothers of St. Joseph” other than the rights,
liabilities and obligations referred to in subsection (1) on the
day immediately prior to the date of the commencement of
this  Act,  shall  be  deemed  to  be  the  rights,  liabilities  and
obligations  of  the  “Society  of  the  Sri  Lankan  Brothers  of
Charity”.

4.
In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala
and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
